verdict.rationale: Ollama's docs claim local runs never leave the machine and prompts are never tracked or trained on, implying no telemetry for local usage, but there is no explicit settings/flag documented for opting out of any telemetry (e.g., update checks, cloud usage analytics) and no independent confirmation of a telemetry toggle. missing for 10: explicit opt-out mechanism/config flag for telemetry, documentation on what data (if any) is collected by the app/cloud, independent verification of no telemetry.
